title: H-STEAMNET-1 - the Steam networking config (ICE direct path Private|Public = 6, send rate 1-16 MB/s, send buffer 8 MB) is applied by the STARTUP watcher on BOTH instances, before any socket exists, and the DEV lever 'steamnet' reports it. The rig joins by DIRECT IP only, so no Steam link exists here: the direct/relayed status line, the per-connection override and the 30 s checks are REVIEW-VERIFIED ONLY until a real two-account Steam session. The lever runs before hosting, while hosting + an IP client is in the lobby (links=0 - the IP link is not a Steam link), and the Steam relay listener must still start. NO save, no world load.
preconditions: Dev build with SteamNetConfig (BAMP_DEV lever 'steamnet'). Steam valid on BOTH instances (the rig's usual state: '[Steam] client valid' in both logs). UDP 7777 FREE (no dummy socket - that is t-steamnet-hostport).

steps.expect_result: ^OK steamnet config:\ ICE=-1\ sendRate=262144\-262144\ sendBuffer=524288\ applied=True\ at='startup'\ links=0$
steps.note: PREMISE + proof: read-back values, applied by the startup watcher (at='startup'), before any host/join

steps.expect_result: ^OK steamnet config:\ ICE=-1\ sendRate=262144\-262144\ sendBuffer=524288\ applied=True\ at='startup'\ links=0$

steps.note: the Steam listener still starts after the config (EnsureApplied guard is a no-op once applied)

steps.expect_result: ^OK steamnet config:\ ICE=-1\ sendRate=262144\-262144\ sendBuffer=524288\ applied=True\ at='startup'\ links=0$
steps.note: hosting with an IP client: still links=0 - the direct-IP link is LiteNetLib, not a Steam connection

steps.expect_result: ^OK steamnet config:\ ICE=-1\ sendRate=262144\-262144\ sendBuffer=524288\ applied=True\ at='startup'\ links=0$
